ImagingFillRadialGradient(const char *mode) {
    Imaging im;
    int x, y;
    int d;

    if (strlen(mode) != 1) {
        return (Imaging)ImagingError_ModeError();
    }

    im = ImagingNewDirty(mode, 256, 256);
    if (!im) {
        return NULL;

                    ((FLOAT32 *)im->image32[y])[x] = (FLOAT32)d;
                } else {
                    im->image32[y][x] = d;
                }

            }
        }
